concepts.label: Infrastructure Incident
concepts.description: Hardware, compute, hypervisor, or OS issues.

concepts.label: Data & Storage Incident
concepts.description: Database, cache, message broker, or pipeline issues.

concepts.label: Security & Access Incident
concepts.description: Unauthorized access, breach, credential leak, or policy violation.

concepts.label: Billing & Commercial Incident
concepts.description: Invoicing, payment processing, subscription, or checkout errors.

concepts.label: Application Error
concepts.description: Client UI glitches, 5xx server exceptions, or logic bugs.

concepts.label: Database Outage
concepts.description: Complete loss of primary DB or replica cluster connectivity.

concepts.label: Database Deadlock
concepts.description: Concurrent transactions blocked waiting for conflicting locks.

concepts.label: Data Pipeline Stall
concepts.description: Kafka lag, Celery/Airflow failure, or consumer crash.

concepts.label: Authentication Breach
concepts.description: Compromised credentials, unauthorized token issuance, or brute-force attack.

concepts.label: DDoS Attack
concepts.description: High-volume distributed traffic overwhelming ingress points.

concepts.label: Payment Gateway Failure
concepts.description: Stripe/Adyen/banking webhook failures or payment processing errors.

concepts.label: Invoice Calculation Error
concepts.description: Incorrect tax, discount, or pricing tier billing error.
